name: Silver Butterfly Tiara
description: A beautiful princess tiara crafted with silver butterflies that stand tall for a royal look. The base is woven with delicate sliver wire, decorated with shiny white pearls and beads, and sparkling crysals.
description2: It is lightweight and sits comfortably on the head to make your little girl feel like royalty. This crown can be customized in any color combination to match her dress.
